 The answer above the links
 Google answers first. Are you in it? 
 1 An answer you cannot see into
 Search for your trade in Horsham and Google now answers with an AI summary before the links. You do not know if you appear in it, or why the firms that do are there.
 2 Why the map and AI overlap
 Those AI answers lean on the same signals as the map: reviews, a complete profile and clear facts on your site. Gaps there make you harder to include in either.
 3 What Andy keeps in order
 Your profile kept complete and current, reviews coming in after every job, and a monthly report that shows where you stand.

 AI SEO and GEO
 Getting quoted by AI is work you can scope, not buy 
 AI SEO and GEO are how a Horsham firm becomes easier for AI to understand and quote. AI SEO covers Google and its AI Overviews, and generative engine optimisation (GEO) covers ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. Andy prices both to the size of the job. He cannot guarantee a citation, and nothing can be promised about what Google's AI answers will say, so the checks simply record what is there.
 AI SEO
 Keyword and content strategy built around the questions buyers ask AI
 Pages structured so AI answers can quote them
 Technical foundations: speed, indexing, schema and internal linking
 Plain-English reporting on rankings, citations and enquiries
 GEO (generative engine optimisation)
 Key pages restructured into clear, quotable answers
 Structured data stating your services, prices, location and credentials
 AI crawler access and an llms.txt file
 Consistent business facts across the sources AI models read
 Monthly checks across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews
 Off the table
 No promises about rankings or AI answers 
 Andy will not sell you a position on Google, on the map or inside an AI summary. These items sit outside the monthly work in Horsham, and it is better to know that before you start.

 The monthly report
 What it shows: your place on the map 
 The report shows where your business appears on Google Maps from a spread of points across Horsham and your villages. LocalFalcon runs the same search from each point and records your position.
 It measures the map and not AI answers, which are checked separately under GEO if you choose it. Knowing the basics are holding is still the sensible first step for anyone worried about AI summaries.
 A short written summary comes with each report, setting out the month's work in plain language.

 Straight answers
 What Horsham firms ask about AI and maps 
 Can you get me into Google's AI answers?
 No one can promise that. Google decides what appears, drawing on things like reviews, a complete profile and clear facts on your site. The service works on those signals, and Andy will not claim more than that.
 Would you take on a firm in Billingshurst or Southwater?
 Yes. Both can sit on your report alongside Horsham and any other villages you serve.
 What do I need to do each month?
 Very little. You approve the posts and, if you want to, reply to the odd review yourself.
 What is GEO, and is it different from local SEO?
 GEO means generative engine optimisation: preparing your pages, facts and structured data so AI tools can read and quote them. Local SEO centres on the Google map and your profile. They are separate pieces of work, and GEO is priced to scope.
 Will AI SEO change my map rankings?
 Not directly, and it is not sold as if it will. AI SEO works on your website and how it is read by Google and AI Overviews, whereas the map depends mostly on your profile, reviews and location.
 Do I need a new website for any of this?
 Not necessarily. If yours is thin or out of date, Horsham website design comes from the same business, starting at £600.
 Is there a contract?
 You and Andy agree the terms in writing before any work begins.
 How much is local SEO in Horsham?
 It starts at £497 a month on a written scope. Anything on the AI side is extra and priced to the job.

The person behind it
 Andy Norman, local SEO for Horsham firms 
 Andy Norman is the founder of Antek Automation and the person who does the SEO work for its Horsham clients. He spent more than 30 years in field service and managed print first.
 He is careful about what he says on AI search because so much of it is oversold. He will tell a Horsham business what can be improved and be equally plain about what nobody controls.
 What he will and will not claim
 Andy can keep your profile complete, your reviews coming and your facts consistent. He cannot make Google or any AI tool mention you, and he says so before you pay.
